title: Darwin's MZ Stuff - Merry Third Advent Sunday

posts.author: DarwinDarstein
posts.body:
Sup,
You people are getting me into the Christmas Spirit this year.
I don't have enough to fill a whole 24 doors but I should at least be able to drop something in every now and then.
To the very least Saint Nicolas Day and Christmas Day should be possible.
I hope I can drop some more stuff from time to time. Fingers Crossed for a better work schedule in 2026.
Terms
MZ Edits are only for RPG Maker MZ (or any other RPG Maker Engine if you possess RPG Maker MZ)
Engine-Free Assets are okay in any Engine. They are just optimized for RPG Maker. Which means 48x48 plus the colors are picked so it fits right into the RTP.
Free for commercial and non-commercial use.
Don't claim as your own. Credit me as Darwin Darstein.
Edits are allowed. But only share-able under the same terms.
Let me know when you use them - I'm curious. A free copy would be even sweeter. o.o
Tiles
MZ Edits; Architecture
Not a big fan of the Wall and Roof Tiles in MZ's RTP so I modified them.
They are simply too chunky.
Also here's some timber-frame and thatch roofing because they're a staple.
MZ Edits; Nature
A slim tree and bush replacer that fit the RTP wide tree.
And here some tropical tiles for a small bamboo forest.

posts.author: DarwinDarstein
posts.body:
A Merry Second Advent
Yup, yet another German. This one's "anner Waterkant born", so Moin I guess.
Actually found some more stuff. Made a few extra pieces so they don't feel too mix and match.
Let's start with some Exterior Assets. I really missed Mack's well when moving from 32x32 to 48x48 so i made my own MZ version of it. Then a village gate, some pillars and blocky versions of the RTP wooden fence. Also some processed wood for good measure.
Edit; Exterior Clutter
Then some rural interior. Same pillar but lighter colored. Also some recolored floor tiles I needed when converting an Ace project to MZ. Used the violet rug as a base for a less fancy one.
Edit; Interior Objects
Last but not least more tropical tiles. Used my lazy thatch roof edit as a base to make a weighted thatch roof and my bamboo forest autotile for a wall. Thrown in a smoking rack for some Cast Away vibes. Somehow you gotta preserve your food, right?
